text:
Marta (CS): quick roll-up from today's onboarding triage — noticed 4 repeated asks across trials: 1) a sharable 'feature-ask rollup' (not just CSV) that groups asks by route + account, 2) route-owner tagging in Console so AMs know who to ping, 3) an onboarding readiness scorecard per account (TTF + checklist progress), 4) an embeddings snapshot export so customers can store hashes before a model swap.
Gabe (PM): nice summary. the rollup feed idea is interesting — product wants an export + small API so roadmap/eng can auto-ingest. prioritization: rollup feed > route-owner tags > readiness scorecard > snapshot export.
Marta (CS): two customers flagged renewal concern if costs keep spiking — one enterprise in 18 days. adding "renewal_sensitive" flag to high-impact rows.
Inez (SE): dev thoughts: rollup feed (backend aggregation + small API + UI link) ~5 dev days; route-owner tagging (DB field + UI + permissions) ~3 dev days; readiness scorecard (analytics + dashboard card) ~1 sprint; snapshot export (export endpoint that bundles embeddings metadata) ~4 dev days. will need telemetry: `route.owner_id`, `route.token_usage.daily`, `onboarding.step.completed`.
Sam (Enablement): can own copy and the AM outreach script. suggestion for quick mitigation: a 7-day banner for newly created routes and a 10% experiment showing top-consuming route in Console. low lift and may reduce surprise.
Marta (CS): sample verbatim quotes to paste in tickets: "Our sandbox route quietly ate through tokens during load testing. We only saw it on the invoice — we'll pause expansion if this happens again." and "After the model swap our relevancy dropped; having a snapshot we can restore to would help."
Gabe (PM): let's use a simple triage formula for this batch: score = (renewal_urgency*4)+(mrr_bucket*5)+(reproducibility*2) where renewal_urgency: <=30d=5 else 1; mrr_bucket: Low/Med/High=1/3/5. anything >=14 gets urgent outreach.
Inez (SE): agreed. small ask: CS can you include a 3-row CSV sample for the rollup feed (headers + 2 examples). sample headers proposal: `account_id,account_name,tier,route_id,route_name,owner_id,ask_summary,impact,severity,renewal_date,renewal_sensitive`
Marta (CS): paste sample in ticket body: ```account_id,account_name,tier,route_id,route_name,owner_id,ask_summary,impact,severity,renewal_date,renewal_sensitive
ACME-77,Acme Corp,Enterprise,R-33,agent-qa,AM-Jordan,"Feature-ask rollup export","Shareable list for PMs",4,2024-08-10,true
NOVA-2,Nova LLC,Mid,R-8,search-prod,AM-Liu,"Re-embed snapshot export","Relevancy dropped after model swap",3,2024-11-01,false```
alert-bot: created ticket CS-128401 "Feature-ask rollup feed" and CS-128402 "Route-owner tags + quick banner experiment". assigned CS-128401 -> @Gabe, CS-128402 -> @Inez.
Gabe (PM): slotting CS-128401 in next sprint; will draft acceptance criteria: API spec for feed, CSV schema (as above), sample webhook for ingestion, and permutation of owner lookup.
Marta (CS): i'll batch up 10 raw asks with quotes, tiers, renewal windows, and run the triage score tonight. will attach to CS-128401 and ping AMs for outreach list.
Inez (SE): will follow-up with exact estimates and telemetry schema tomorrow. if anything needs urgent mitigation we can enable the banner experiment asap.
Sam (Enablement): prepping the 15s microvideo + AM script. good call on the owner tags — will help reduce back-and-forth.
Gabe (PM): thanks all — please keep samples concise. Marta, once you upload the scored bundle i'll move tickets to triage and invite AMs for any >=14 items. :raised_hands:
